# Frequent Research

> Frequent Research (Frequent Research Fieldwork Solutions Pvt. Ltd., New Delhi, India) is a market research and fieldwork company that also runs digital marketing, IT & development, and accounts & finance teams. It operates its own research panels (Turn2Opinion, MyFrequentRewards, MyHealthOpinions), builds research software (Sampledge), and is certified to ISO 20252:2019, ISO 9001:2015 and ISO/IEC 27001:2013, and is an ESOMAR member.

Key facts:
- Four teams: Market Research, Digital Marketing, IT & Development, Accounts & Finance.
- Research panels: Turn2Opinion (consumers and business professionals), MyFrequentRewards (consumers and professionals), MyHealthOpinions (healthcare professionals, patients and caregivers).
- Products: the Sampledge product family, seven products: SampCode, SampBidx, SampTrek, SampAudience, SampForce, Talk2Tax and SampCrew, each with its own page at /products/<name>.
- Contact: info@frequentresearch.com · +91 81782 00573 (also WhatsApp) · Mangolpur Kalan, New Delhi 110085, India.
- Panel sizes by country are published in the downloadable panel books; historical figures on the Our Journey page are milestones, not current panel sizes.
